rust.name: src/measure.rs:306:89: replace > with >= in Run<'a>::texts

rust.why: Clearing stale reports is now a helper called in three places; a test only fails if a leftover report gets read as this run's, which is likely untested.

rust.name: src/measure.rs:247:17: replace == with != in Run<'a>::prefix
rust.why: The root "." check moved into Run; samples rooted at "." may never reach the non-root branch, so flipping it could go unnoticed.

rust.name: src/measure.rs:338:9: replace Run<'a>::reach -> Result<Option<Vec<formats::TestReach>>> with Ok(Some(vec![]))
rust.why: The only reach test checks None against one entry, so an empty Some (every mutant then runs no selected tests) may still pass.

rust.name: src/measure/mutants.rs:233:71: replace && with || in mutate_picks
rust.why: This matches a pick to its reported mutant by file, line and description; with a single mutant per test run, loosening the match to || would still find the right one.
